testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/plp/verify-wishlist-detail-for-retail-user-from-quick-view-for-simple-product.spec.ts > PLP - Wishlist Detail for Retail User from Quick View (Simple Product) > verify wishlist detail for retail user from quick view for simple product

scenario.summary: A registered user signs in with the test's own account, clears the wishlist, searches a simple product by SKU and checks its PLP card, adds it to the wishlist from Quick View (toast), finds it on the Wishlist page, searches again and removes it from the wishlist from Quick View (toast).
steps: Guest context; open the webstore, sign in from the header with username/password; check the greeting contains 'Hello,'.
Clear the wishlist; search the SKU; check the first PLP card name, SKU and retail price.
Open Quick View and click the wishlist heart; check the 'added' toast.
Open the Wishlist page; check the product link with the product name is visible.
Search the SKU again and repeat the PLP card checks.
Open Quick View and click the heart again; check the 'removed' toast. afterEach clears the wishlist.
stateChanges: The declared account's wishlist is cleared at start (and in afterEach), the product is added from Quick View and removed again (wishlist ends empty).
assertions: First PLP card shows the product name, SKU and retail price '$149.99' (twice).
Toast 'Product added to your Wishlist.'; Wishlist page lists the product name.
evidence: Title 'verify wishlist detail for retail user from quick view for simple product' and step labels 0) to 5) match the flow; no linked cases.

DECLARED ACCOUNT: the spec opts out of the shared session (test.use storageState empty) and signs in from the header with username/password from its own JSON (credential sources, masked in the scan, profile SENSITIVE). USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED preferred.required true on the username source; the migrated test declares it with testData.useExisting('user', data.username) before signing in.

Profile: z-2430008 FOUND as active SimpleProduct, PRODUCTION, inventory 250, storefrontProductIndex 1, but requiredAddOnCount 1 (tda rows: PimProductId 484). PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK requires no required add-ons, so the recorded product does not qualify and the resolver falls back to another simple product; a required add-on plays no part in wishlisting, and PRODUCT_SIMPLE_WITH_REQUIRED_ADDON would add a constraint the test does not need.

quantityUsed 1: the product is only wishlisted. sku1 -> product.sku, productName1 -> product.name, price1 ($149.99, card retail price) -> product.retailPrice (now an output of PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK).
No data value in the spec code (the PLP card is read through firstProductHeading/firstProductSkuValue/firstProductRetailPrice); the spec reads its JSON through loadData.
migrate: the asserted retail price depends on the product (swap rule 3 fails).
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store every migrated webstore spec runs on (as in the approved shopping-cart, checkout and PDP entries); not named in the scan.
